subtasks.title: Create defaults/mcp.json scaffold file
subtasks.description: Create the file `teamai/defaults/mcp.json` containing `{ "mcpServers": {} }`. This is the canonical empty MCP config that `projectStore.scaffold()` will copy into new projects. Mirrors the existing `defaults/pipeline.json` and `defaults/providers.json` pattern — a static JSON file with no logic.
acceptance_criteria: File exists at teamai/defaults/mcp.json
Contents are exactly { "mcpServers": {} } (valid JSON)

subtasks.title: Create server actions module: src/app/actions/mcp.ts
subtasks.description: Create `teamai/src/app/actions/mcp.ts` following the exact pattern of `providers.ts`. Export TypeScript interfaces `McpServerEntry` and `McpConfig`, a module-level `DEFAULT` constant (`{ mcpServers: {} }`), and two server actions: `getMcpConfig(): Promise<McpConfig>` (reads `<projectRoot>/.mcp.json`, falls back to DEFAULT on missing or malformed JSON) and `saveMcpConfig(config: McpConfig): Promise<void>` (writes `<projectRoot>/.mcp.json` via `JSON.stringify(config, null, 2)`, then calls `revalidatePath('/settings')`). Use `getActiveProjectPath()` to resolve the project root. Wrap the file read in try/catch — on any error (ENOENT, SyntaxError) return DEFAULT. McpServerEntry shape: `{ command: string; args?: string[]; env?: Record<string, string>; type: 'stdio' }`. McpConfig shape: `{ mcpServers: Record<string, McpServerEntry> }`.
acceptance_criteria: getMcpConfig returns { mcpServers: {} } when .mcp.json is absent
getMcpConfig returns { mcpServers: {} } when .mcp.json contains invalid JSON (AC-12)
saveMcpConfig writes config as pretty-printed JSON to <projectRoot>/.mcp.json
saveMcpConfig calls revalidatePath('/settings') after writing

subtasks.title: Extend ProcessManager.createSession with mcpConfigPath
subtasks.description: In `teamai/src/lib/process-manager.ts`, add `mcpConfigPath?: string` to the opts parameter of `createSession()`. In the native spawn branch: when `mcpConfigPath` is truthy, push `'--mcp-config'` and `mcpConfigPath` onto `claudeArgs` before spawning. In the container (docker exec) branch: when `mcpConfigPath` is truthy, translate the host path to the container path via the existing `hostToContainerPath` helper, then push `'--mcp-config'` and the translated path onto the docker exec argument list. When `mcpConfigPath` is falsy or absent, do not add the flag in either branch. No other changes.
acceptance_criteria: When mcpConfigPath is provided, --mcp-config <path> appears in the spawned process args (AC-7)
When mcpConfigPath is absent, --mcp-config does not appear in spawned process args (AC-8)
In container mode, --mcp-config uses the container-translated path, not the host path (AC-9)

subtasks.title: Scaffold .mcp.json in projectStore.scaffold()
subtasks.description: In `teamai/src/lib/project-store.ts`, inside the `scaffold(projectPath)` private method, add a step that copies `defaults/mcp.json` to `<projectPath>/.mcp.json`. Mirror exactly the existing pattern used for `pipeline.json` and `providers.json`: resolve the source path relative to `DEFAULTS_DIR`, check `existsSync(dest)` before copying (never overwrite), then `fs.copyFileSync(src, dest)`. The destination is `path.join(projectPath, '.mcp.json')` (project root, not inside `.teamai/`).
acceptance_criteria: When scaffold() runs for a project with no .mcp.json, the file is created at <projectRoot>/.mcp.json containing { "mcpServers": {} } (AC-10)
When scaffold() runs for a project that already has .mcp.json, the file is not overwritten (backwards compat)

subtasks.title: Pass mcpConfigPath to createSession in orchestrator
subtasks.description: In `teamai/src/lib/orchestrator.ts`, update every call to `processManager.createSession(this.sessionOpts(...))` to also pass `mcpConfigPath`. Resolve the candidate path as `path.join(this.projectRoot, '.mcp.json')` at the top of the class (or inline per call). Before passing, check `existsSync(mcpConfigPath)`; pass the resolved absolute path only when the file exists, omit otherwise. The `sessionOpts()` helper already merges options — you can spread the MCP path in at the call site: `processManager.createSession({ ...this.sessionOpts(role, cwd, taskId, logFile), mcpConfigPath: ... })`. Touch all call sites (runSpec, runPlan, runImplement, runQaReview, runQaFix, runMerge, and any other phase runners that call createSession).
acceptance_criteria: When <projectRoot>/.mcp.json exists, all createSession calls include mcpConfigPath pointing to it
When <projectRoot>/.mcp.json does not exist, createSession is called without mcpConfigPath

subtasks.title: Create McpConfigEditor client component
subtasks.description: Create `teamai/src/components/mcp-config.tsx` as a `'use client'` React component. Props: `{ initialConfig: McpConfig }`. Internal state holds an array of draft entries (name + command + args string + env pairs). Render a list of server entries; each row shows name, command, args, env key-value pairs, and a Delete button. Provide an "Add Server" button that appends a blank entry. On Save: validate (no empty name, no empty command, no duplicate names), show inline field-level errors if invalid, or call `saveMcpConfig()` server action with the assembled `McpConfig` object and show a success toast. Serialize args from the UI string to `string[]` by splitting on commas or newlines (trim whitespace, drop empties). Env pairs are rendered as a small key-value editor (add/remove rows). Import `McpConfig`, `McpServerEntry`, and `saveMcpConfig` from `@/app/actions/mcp`. Use shadcn/ui primitives (Button, Input, Label) matching the style of existing editors in the settings page. Empty state message: 'No MCP servers configured'.
acceptance_criteria: Empty state shows 'No MCP servers configured' and 'Add Server' button (AC-2)
Add Server appends a blank entry; user can fill name/command/args/env and click Save (AC-3)
Duplicate server names produce inline validation error; file is not written (AC-4)
Empty command produces inline validation error; file is not written (AC-5)
Delete button removes entry; Save writes updated config without that server (AC-6)
Env vars are stored under server.env as a string-keyed object (AC-11)

subtasks.title: Integrate MCP Servers section into Settings page
subtasks.description: In `teamai/src/app/settings/page.tsx`, add the MCP Servers section below the existing sections (after the Providers Config section, before Agent Roles). Import `getMcpConfig` from `'../actions/mcp'` and `McpConfigEditor` from `'@/components/mcp-config'`. Add `getMcpConfig()` to the existing `Promise.all(...)` parallel fetch at the top of the component. Render a new section block matching the layout of existing sections: an H2 with text 'MCP Servers', a descriptive paragraph ('Configure MCP servers available to all pipeline agents in this project.'), and `<McpConfigEditor initialConfig={mcpConfig} />`. Do not change the layout of existing sections.
acceptance_criteria: Navigating to /settings shows an 'MCP Servers' section (AC-1)
The section renders McpConfigEditor with data fetched via getMcpConfig (AC-2)

subtasks.title: Unit tests for MCP server actions
subtasks.description: Create `teamai/src/__tests__/mcp-actions.test.ts`. Mock `fs/promises` (or `fs`) and the `getActiveProjectPath` helper. Test cases: (1) `getMcpConfig` returns DEFAULT when file does not exist; (2) `getMcpConfig` returns DEFAULT when file contains invalid JSON (AC-12); (3) `getMcpConfig` returns parsed config when file is valid; (4) `saveMcpConfig` writes correct JSON to the expected path; (5) `saveMcpConfig` calls `revalidatePath('/settings')`. Use Jest (already configured in the project). Follow the file naming and mock patterns used in existing `src/__tests__/` tests.
acceptance_criteria: All 5 test cases pass with npm test
Malformed JSON fallback is explicitly covered (AC-12)

subtasks.title: Unit tests for ProcessManager --mcp-config flag
subtasks.description: Create `teamai/src/__tests__/process-manager-mcp.test.ts`. Mock child_process.spawn (and docker exec path) to capture the argument list. Test cases: (1) When `mcpConfigPath` is provided in createSession opts, the spawned command includes `--mcp-config <path>` (AC-7); (2) When `mcpConfigPath` is absent, `--mcp-config` does not appear in args (AC-8); (3) When container mode is active and `mcpConfigPath` is provided, the docker exec args include `--mcp-config <container-path>` using the translated path (AC-9). Follow patterns from existing ProcessManager tests in `src/__tests__/`.
acceptance_criteria: All 3 test cases pass with npm test
Native path (AC-7), absent path (AC-8), and container path translation (AC-9) are each tested
